changes.description: New building controllers are now created with Registry Sync enabled (they used to start disabled). Unarchive still restores the node with Asset Registry off.

The Create and Unarchive Faculties dropdown now offers only the faculties the chosen Campus Hub grants, as Manage Faculties already did. "No faculties available" shows when the Campus Hub grants none.
The Relay Association dropdown on the Building Controller panel now lists only Relays from the node's own campus.

The Relay's Manage → Building Controllers list and the Create form's Relay building-controller list now show every active building controller on the Campus Hub, including nodes created or unarchived after load.
The Create form's Relay Campus Hub dropdown now marks NORT nodes with "(NORT)", and picking an NORT Campus Hub lists its building controllers.

The Create form's Relay building-controller checks now stay as you set them when the Building Controller hostname, faculties or Campus Hub change, and the "(new)" row only shows while the Building Controller section is on.
The same hostname or IP typed in two sections of the Create form is now reported as already in use.
The Create drawer's Close button now asks for confirmation only when you have changed something, including Node Type, Proxy URL, Alert and Relay picks. A freshly opened form closes straight away.

Unarchive now runs the same checks as Move (Campus Hub, required fields, IP format, duplicates) and attaches the Relay you pick. An archived node with no faculties opens with no faculties checked and shows its errors straight away.
Unarchiving a Relay now keeps the Campus Hub and building controllers you choose and clears a stale outdated Proxy URL flag. Unarchiving a Campus Hub no longer wipes its Proxy URL.
The Create form now rejects a hostname or IP that matches a faculty-less building controller.
A building controller with no faculties keeps its "No Faculties selected" hint when archived, and its first added faculty now shows immediately.

Archived faculty-less building controllers now show the Archived tag in search, turn Show Archived on when picked, and no longer block archiving their Campus Hub. Three archived NORT nodes that never had a faculty are now in the tree.
"Remove all faculties, then Archive" now archives the node instead of leaving it active.
Faculty-less building controllers now appear in the Associated Building Controllers lists on Campus Hub and Relay panels.

Changing a filter keeps the selected node and the branches you collapsed. Ending a bulk selection with a filter change returns to the empty panel, and changing the Campus selection also clears a bulk selection.

Bulk selection: a single remaining pick becomes an ordinary selection, a Shift range from a non-selectable row selects just the clicked row, a Shift+Click with nothing selected picks that row, a plain click on a greyed-out row ends the selection, and Save stays off for a selection with no building controllers.
The bulk panel notice now compares each picked campus's own faculties when deciding whether filters narrow the change.
Saving a Campus's Asset Registry change now reports "Registry Sync applied to N Building Controllers" (nothing when Asset Registry refused every node).
Create Node and Manage are re-enabled whenever the details panel is cleared, and the panel title resets to its default.

Renaming a faculty-less building controller while changing its Campus Hub now updates the old Campus Hub's list correctly, and changing an archived node's Campus Hub no longer strips its faculty history.
The Campus Hub link on a Relay panel is enabled only when that Campus Hub is in the tree. The faculty icon in Manage Faculties and the Create form now matches the exact Campus Hub.
Escape closes only the confirmation popover when one is open, in the Create drawer and the Manage drawers. Confirming an archive re-checks that it is still allowed.
The Network Transport label on the Relay panel and the Associated Timetable Relay section now reads Network Protocol, matching the other panels.
"Node not visible in current view" now shows as a warning.
The CSV export no longer doubles quote characters in Description and Location.
The seed data no longer has duplicate node IDs or hostnames (nort-bc1-1 now has one ID, and the archived arts-bc01-2 twin is renamed arts-bc01-2-old).
The Campus Asset Registry save toast now counts a building controller in several faculties once.

On the Building Controller side panel, the Relay Association dropdown is now disabled for archived Building Controllers, with the note "Archived Building Controllers cannot be associated with Timetable Relays." below the field. Added to the requirements (FR-P2-24).

The "Building Controllers need their Proxy URL updated manually" toast after a Campus Hub rename now matches the Asset Registry failure toast: regular weight, no "Warning:" label or icon, a larger close icon, and a "Details" link button (was "View details").
Renaming the master Campus Hub (hub.atrium.test) no longer asks for the "Change Hostname" confirmation. It saves straight through. Added to the requirements (FR-P2-25).
Building Controllers with no faculties can now be archived. They stay in the tree as archived (Registry Sync off) and can be unarchived.

The Bulk and Campus Registry Sync failure toast now reads "Unable to update N Building Controllers Registry Sync status" in regular weight, with no "Warning:" label or icon (like the other toasts on this page), a larger close icon, and a "Details" link button.

The Asset Registry failures dialog now has a red error icon and the title "Unable to update N Building Controllers Registry Sync status", a Details column (was Errors) and sortable columns. Close is secondary and Copy list is primary. The Proxy URL dialog gets the same sortable columns and buttons.
Toast action links (Details, and View details on the Proxy URL toast) now use the design-system link button.

The Create Node drawer (Create, Unarchive, Move) now treats an underivable Building Controller or Relay Proxy URL the same way as the side panels: an orange warning under the field instead of an error, and Save stays available. An empty Proxy URL is still required.

On the Building Controller and Relay panels, a Proxy URL that can't be generated after a Hostname change now shows an orange warning ("Proxy URL is outdated and can't be generated from this Hostname. Enter it manually.") instead of an error. The field still holds a URL, so Save stays available.

In the Create drawer, the "Proxy URL updated because the Campus Hub changed" warning no longer sticks after other changes: it now names the latest change, and clears when the new Hostname or Campus Hub can't produce a URL.
The Alert Service switch no longer has help text, in the Create drawer or the Building Controller panel.

The Building Controller panel's Relay Association now follows the Create drawer: it is disabled with "Select a Campus Hub first" when no Campus Hub is chosen and "No Relays for this Campus Hub" when the Campus Hub has none, and enables as soon as the Campus Hub has a Relay.

Bulk and Campus Registry Sync failures now show one warning toast ("N Building Controllers could not be updated…") with a View details link. It opens a dialog listing each refused Building Controller, its campus and the message from Asset Registry, with a Copy list button. New examples: lab-bc01-2, lab-bc01-3 and lab-bc02-1 are refused; lab-bc02-2 and lab-bc02-3 are accepted.

Renaming a Campus Hub now includes its Timetable Relays: the confirmation, the note under the hostname, the warning toast counters and the details modal count Building Controllers and Timetable Relays, and the modal has a Type column. Relay Proxy URLs are regenerated or flagged like Building Controllers'. Example: rvrs-rly1-1 has a hand-typed Proxy URL.

New Error Cases button on the DaVinci ribbon (this prototype only). It opens a panel listing the hidden error, blocked and warning states, such as the Asset Registry refusal, the registered-devices check, archive and move blocks and unarchive with an archived Campus Hub, each with the steps to reach it.

Asset Registry refusals now show one two-line error toast for archive, disabling Registry Sync and changing the hostname, in bulk and Campus changes too: "Unable to <action>, Registry Sync change was not successful." followed by the message from the registry. Example: lab-bc01-1, a new faculty-less Building Controller that replaces nort-bc1-1 as the example.
The archive popover's devices warning no longer shows a device count; it says the Building Controller has devices registered to it.

Renaming a Campus Hub now asks for confirmation on Save and affects every connected Building Controller. The popover opens at once, with no loading state, and shows a warning that carries the count of connected Building Controllers (no list, no split between generated and manual URLs). The note under the hostname field no longer shows a count. Generated Proxy URLs follow the new hostname; any other URL is kept and flagged Proxy URL outdated, and that Building Controller's panel blocks Save until a new URL is entered. Buttons: Keep Editing / Yes, Save. Example: rvrs-hub, where rvrs-bc2-3 has a hand-typed URL.

After a Campus Hub rename, a warning toast tells you when Building Controllers need their Proxy URL updated manually. Its View details link opens a modal with a table of those Building Controllers (hostname, campus, current Proxy URL) and a Copy list button. The tree and legend flag outdated hostnames only.

Archived Building Controllers in a Campus Hub's Associated Building Controllers list now carry the Archived tag. New example: rvrs-hub2 is served only by archived Building Controllers, so it can be archived.
Documented that the hostname suffix comes from the server (meta.hostnameSuffix) and that a hostname equal to the suffix is valid. Requirements updated to v2.39.

The archive confirmation no longer says it will turn off Registry Sync when they are already off. Its buttons now read Keep Building Controller / Keep Timetable Relay / Keep Campus Hub and Yes, Archive.

The valid hostname suffix is now the same on all three node types: atrium.test. Seed Building Controller and Relay hostnames, placeholders and hints were moved over. Campus Hub hostnames already used it, so Open Question 14 is closed.

Alert Service can now be enabled on any Building Controller, with or without a Relay. Removed the rules that disabled it without a Relay and reset it to Off when the Relay was removed or the Campus Hub changed, and the Alert sentence in the Campus Hub-change confirmation.

Removed the deprecated passThroughURL from Campus Hub and Relay records. The Building Controller Proxy URL, previously also called passThroughURL, is now stored as proxyURL like the others. Campus Hub records keep proxyURL for now, although the field is no longer shown.

Asset Registry can now refuse to remove a host that still has devices that aren't retired. Example: nort-bc1-1. Turning Registry Sync off, archiving, or renaming it shows an error and changes nothing; in bulk and Campus changes only the refused nodes are skipped and reported.
The Relay Proxy URL short name and the Relay hostname hint said rly<row>-<n>; they now say rly<floor>-<n>.

Requirements cleanup after archived Building Controllers became non-bulk-selectable: removed the rules for an all-archived bulk selection (disabled Asset Registry toggle), for skipping archived nodes on a mixed bulk Save, and for skipping archived nodes when a Campus cascade turns Asset Registry on. Archived nodes are simply never in scope, so the toast count, the Campus Asset Registry state and the edge-case table no longer mention them.
Removed the now-unreachable code for those rules in bulk-mode.js and selection.js (all-archived toggle lock, skip-archived on Save, archived write-through in the Campus Asset Registry cascade).
A Campus whose only Building Controllers are archived now reads Asset Registry as Unavailable, since archived nodes are no longer counted in the Campus scope.
Archived Building Controllers can no longer be selected in bulk, and a Campus selection no longer includes them.
A Campus Hub whose only Building Controllers or Timetable Relays are archived can now be archived.
Archiving a Building Controller now checks for attached devices: a loading state first, then a warning with the device count, or a warning that the check failed. Neither blocks archiving.

The Proxy URL now updates automatically when the Hostname or Campus Hub changes, on the details panels and in Create Node, Unarchive and Move. An orange warning says when an existing URL was replaced.
The Generate button is gone from every Proxy URL field.
When a Proxy URL can't be generated from the new Hostname or Campus Hub, the old one is marked as outdated and Save is blocked until a new URL is entered.
Renaming a Campus Hub now updates the Proxy URL of every Building Controller on it. A warning under the Hostname field says how many Building Controllers will be updated.
The master Campus Hub hub.atrium.test can't be archived. A Building Controller with a Relay, or a Relay serving Building Controllers, can't be archived until that association is removed.
A Campus Hub can't be archived while it still has Building Controllers or Timetable Relays. The menu item says: Remove all associated Building Controllers and Timetable Relays before archiving.
Unarchiving a node whose Campus Hub was also archived shows that Campus Hub as archived, with an error, and asks for a different one.
On a Relay, Manage → Building Controllers now lists Building Controllers that are on another Relay as disabled, showing which Relay they're on.
Each field now shows one message at a time: an error replaces a warning, and a warning replaces the format hint.
The close confirmation now says Keep Unarchiving or Keep Moving instead of Keep Creating.
Editing the IP Address or Description of a Campus Hub can be saved again. A hostname that isn't on atrium.test only blocks Save once you edit it.
An empty required field, such as a missing Proxy URL, shows its error as soon as the details panel opens, so a disabled Save always says why.

Proxy URL is now required on Building Controllers and Timetable Relays — on Create Node, Unarchive, Move and the details panel. Save stays disabled until it is filled; the Generate button still fills it in and clears the error.
IP Address is now editable on the Building Controller, Campus Hub and Relay details panels, directly under Hostname. It must be a valid IPv4 address and not already used by another node.
A Campus Hub's Hostname can now be edited at any time, even while Building Controllers are associated with it. The rename is carried to every Building Controller and Relay that points at it.

Move → To available Campus on the Manage menu of an active Building Controller or Campus Hub. Pick one of the other campuses selected in the header; everything the campus doesn't affect is kept, and Campus Hub, Proxy URL, Faculties and Relay are re-picked on the new campus. Moving is blocked for a Building Controller scheduled for a Timetable Release, and for a Campus Hub that still serves Building Controllers or Timetable Relays — the menu item says why.

A Building Controller now belongs to at most one Timetable Relay. The Building Controller panel has a Relay Association dropdown and a read-only Associated Timetable Relay section; on the Relay side, Manage → Building Controllers and the Create form only offer Building Controllers that don't already have a Relay.
Manage → Timetable Relays is gone from the Building Controller menu — use the Relay Association dropdown on the panel instead.
The failover Relays no longer share Building Controllers with their primary: meds-rly3-1 now serves meds-bc301 and rvrs-rly1-1 serves rvrs-bc1-7.
On the Create form, a Building Controller on an NORT Campus Hub at another campus now sees that Campus Hub's Timetable Relays.
A Building Controller's Hostname is locked while it has faculties associated, with a note explaining why. Archived Building Controllers can't be renamed until they are unarchived.
Search now finds every node, not just the ones the current filters show. Picking a hidden result widens the filters only as far as needed to reveal it.
Save stays disabled while any field on the details panel is invalid. Error messages still appear when you leave the field.
Manage and Create Node are disabled while the details panel has unsaved changes.
The unused Search Settings field is gone from the details panel.
Expanded and collapsed tree branches, including a collapsed campus, now stay as you left them after a save.

Archiving a Building Controller turns Registry Sync off, and it stays off while the node is archived. Unarchiving restores the node with Registry Sync off. Bulk and Campus changes skip archived nodes.
Hostnames are now typed in full and validated to end in atrium.test, with an inline hint and error state.
Outdated hostnames (not on atrium.test) are flagged in orange in the node tree.
Proxy URL is now optional and generated on demand with a Generate button.
Proxy URL field removed from Campus Hubs.

Safety Rules are gone from this page. The Safety Rules section on the Building Controller panel, the bulk Safety Rules section for a Campus or multi-node selection, the Add from Catalog action, the Copy From / Copy To pair, Reset All and the bulk review modal have all been removed. Room safety interlocks are out of scope for Manage Infrastructure.
The Manage menu no longer appears during a multi-node bulk selection. Adding a room safety interlock was the only thing it offered in that mode; every remaining action targets one node.

More nodes in the tree. Eight new Campus Hubs and six new Timetable Relays, spread across every campus that already had them — NORT, RVRS, HLSD and MEDS get Campus Hubs; RVRS, HLSD and MEDS get Relays. NORT has no Relay, and still doesn't: on Connected Campus campuses the Building Controller is its own Relay.

Each campus got one active and one archived node of each type, so the Archive and Unarchive flows now have something to act on everywhere instead of only at MEDS. Turn on 'Show Archived Nodes' to see the archived ones sitting at the bottom of their section.

Every campus now has a spare Campus Hub with no Building Controllers on it — nort-hub-lab (NORT), rvrs-hub2, hlsd-hub2 and meds-hub2. Those are the ones whose Hostname you can edit and which you are allowed to archive; a Campus Hub still serving Building Controllers stays locked on both counts.

meds-rly3-1 and rvrs-rly1-1 are failover Relays covering Building Controllers their campus's main Relay already serves — so a Building Controller panel finally shows more than one entry under Associated Timetable Relays. Nothing changed on the Building Controllers themselves.

hlsd-rly2-1 sits on the NORT master Campus Hub, so it is the first Relay whose Proxy URL is built from its own hostname — 'https://hlsd-rly2-1.atrium.test/relay/' — instead of its Campus Hub's. Archived meds-rly01 carries an old-style name the rule cannot read, so its Proxy URL is left empty with the 'enter it manually' hint.

The Timetable Relay Proxy URL is now filled in for you, the same way a Building Controller's already was. It is built from the Relay's Campus Hub and the Relay's own hostname: a Relay on a local Campus Hub gets 'https://meds-hub.atrium.test/rly1-1/relay/', a Relay on the master Campus Hub (hub.atrium.test) gets 'https://meds-rly1-1.atrium.test/relay/'. Nothing about the rule is new — it is the Building Controller rule with the Relay's own short name and the '/relay/' path in place of '/campus/'.

The field tells you where its value came from. 'Auto-generated from the Hostname and Campus Hub.' while it holds the generated URL, 'Manually edited.' from the first character you change, with a 'Reset to generated URL' link beside it to hand it back. A Relay hostname the rule cannot read says 'Could not be auto-generated from this hostname — enter the Proxy URL manually.' and leaves the field to you.

On the Relay details panel, changing the Campus Hub rewrites the Proxy URL straight away; renaming the Relay rewrites it when you Save. Picking a Campus Hub is one deliberate choice, while a hostname is typed a character at a time — the URL would flicker if it followed every keystroke. Either way, a Proxy URL you typed yourself is never overwritten.

On the Create Node form the Relay Proxy URL moved below Campus Hub Association, so it sits under the field it comes from — the same order the Building Controller section already used. It fills in as soon as the Relay hostname and its Campus Hub are both known, including when the Campus Hub is one you are creating in the same form or inherited from the Building Controller section.
Every existing Relay was given its generated Proxy URL, so no Relay opens with the field looking untouched or reading as hand-edited.
Unarchiving a Relay keeps a Proxy URL you had customised, and keeps following the hostname if you had left it as generated.
Campus Hubs are now the only node type whose Proxy URL is typed by hand.

Manage → Building Controllers on a Campus Hub. The same add/remove checklist the Relay panel has, from the other end: tick a Building Controller to put it on this Campus Hub, untick one to take it off. Worth knowing before you save — a Building Controller only ever has one Campus Hub, so ticking one MOVES it off whatever it is on now, and unticking leaves it with none at all. Rows that would be a move carry a tag naming the Campus Hub they are on today, and the drawer spells out the consequences at the top.

Because that is a real Campus Hub change, everything that normally follows one follows this too: faculties the new Campus Hub doesn't grant are dropped, Relay memberships that no longer share a Campus Hub are detached, Alert Service settles, and the Proxy URL regenerates — unless you had typed your own, which is left alone. Take a Building Controller off a Campus Hub entirely and it loses all its faculties and shows as 'No Faculties selected'.

The Unarchive button on the Campus Hub unarchive drawer was greyed out and stayed that way, so an archived Campus Hub could be opened for unarchive but never actually restored. Building Controller and Relay unarchive were unaffected.
Node Type now sits above Hostname on the Building Controller side panel. The Create Node form already had it that way; the panel did not, so the two disagreed. Same order everywhere now.

Relay Proxy URLs were being generated ending in '/relay/'. Every auto-generated Proxy URL ends in '/campus/' now, Building Controllers and Relays alike — so rvrs-rly1-1 reads https://rvrs-hub.atrium.test/rly1-1/campus/. Only the short name differs between the two rules. A Proxy URL you typed yourself is untouched.

Building Controller and Relay hostnames now all end in atrium.test, and the Hostname field takes care of it for you. You type the short name — 'rvrs-bc1-4' — and '.atrium.test' sits fixed at the end of the field, greyed out and not editable. Paste a full hostname in and it drops the domain rather than doubling it. This is on all four places a hostname is entered: the Building Controller and Relay side panels, and the Building Controller and Relay sections of Create Node. Campus Hubs are not part of this — their field is unchanged.

Every existing Building Controller and Relay was moved onto the new domain, so nothing opens with an old-looking hostname beside the new suffix — meds-bc101.campus.test is now meds-bc101.atrium.test, rvrs-bc1-3.legacy.test is rvrs-bc1-3.atrium.test, meds-rly1-1.legacy.test is meds-rly1-1.atrium.test. Two archived MEDS nodes whose old names only differed by their domain were renamed to meds-bc001-old and meds-bc002-old so no two nodes share a hostname. Campus Hubs were left alone.

Proxy URLs built from the master Campus Hub pick the new domain up automatically — a Building Controller on hub.atrium.test now reads https://meds-bc401.atrium.test/campus/. Which nodes can and can't have their Proxy URL generated has not changed: the ones with legacy short names still show the 'enter it manually' hint.

The search results dropdown now tells you what each column holds. Every node type in the results — Building Controllers, Campus Hubs, Timetable Relays — opens with a header row carrying its icon, its name, and the names of the columns on the right: 'Faculties' and 'ID' for Building Controllers, 'ID' alone for Campus Hub and Relays. The number on the right of a result is the node's ID; until now nothing said so.
A count line sits above the results: '8 results found:'.

Results are now a single line each, reading 'NORT > nort-bc1-2.atrium.test' with the part you typed shown in bold. They used to be two lines — the node name over its full path through the tree. Archived nodes carry the 'Archived' tag, Building Controllers show their faculty tags on the right (up to two, the rest folded into a '+N' you can hover), and every result shows its ID.
Only nodes appear in the results now. Campuses, faculties and the 'Campus Hubs' / 'Timetable Relays' section rows were being matched too, and could not be acted on.
The master Campus Hub is shared by every campus, so it no longer shows a campus name in front of it.
A node reachable from more than one selected campus is listed once instead of twice.
Clicking back into the search field no longer closes the results.
Escape closes the results without clearing what you typed, and a search that matches nothing now says 'No results found' instead of showing nothing.

An archived Building Controller listed under Associated Building Controllers on a Campus Hub or Relay panel no longer offers a link that goes nowhere. While 'Show Archived Nodes' is off the node is not in the tree, so its navigate icon is now disabled and hovering it says to turn the filter on to view it. Turning the filter on restores the link.

Campus Hubs and Relays can now be archived and unarchived, the same way Building Controllers already could. Archive sits under the Manage button and asks for confirmation; a node that still has an associated Building Controller cannot be archived, and the menu entry says why.

The Campus Hub a Building Controller or a Relay belongs to is now a dropdown you can change on the details panel, instead of a value fixed at creation. The read-only Associated Campus Hub section stays as the navigable detail view.

Changing the Campus Hub carries consequences and Atrium applies them together: the old and new Campus Hub reciprocal lists are updated, faculties the new Campus Hub does not grant are removed, Relay memberships on a different Campus Hub are dropped, any Building Controller left with no Relay has Alert Service turned off, and the derived Proxy URL re-generates. When the change would strand something, Save asks first and names what it would break.

Relay and Building Controller membership can be managed from either side, adding and removing, through the same searchable list with ADDING / REMOVING tags — replacing the add-only 'Add Building Controller' action.

A Campus Hub grants its Building Controllers access to a set of faculties, shown read-only on the Campus Hub panel. Moving a Building Controller to a Campus Hub that does not grant one of its faculties removes that faculty; losing all of them leaves the node faculty-less rather than deleting it.
The tree filter is now 'Show Archived Nodes' — it covers all three node types, not just Building Controllers.
The Building Controller Proxy URL now re-generates when the Campus Hub changes, not only on a rename, and a Campus Hub change applies it immediately instead of waiting for Save.

The Timetable Release check no longer applies to Registry Sync. Turning the switch off is never blocked — on the Building Controller panel, in bulk selection, or when cascading from a Campus — and the related inline messages and error toasts are gone. Archiving is unaffected: a Building Controller scheduled for a Timetable Release still cannot be archived until the deploy is cancelled.

A Building Controller scheduled for a Timetable Release can no longer slip past the archive block when opened from a different faculty. Previously only one of its faculty entries carried the flag, so archiving from another branch of the tree was allowed.

Faculties are now optional when unarchiving a Building Controller. Unarchiving with none selected restores it as a Building Controller with no faculties — visible in the tree with the 'No Faculties selected' hint — instead of blocking with a warning. The field label stays 'Faculties (optional)' in both Create and Unarchive.

The Registry Sync note on the bulk and Campus configuration panels now reads 'Use the filters' and responds to the Registry Sync filter as well as the Faculties filter. It previously claimed a change would update every Building Controller in a campus even when a filter was hiding some of them.

The requirements document was reconciled with the prototype. Contradictions were resolved (archived Building Controllers are selectable in bulk; Node Type is the second editable field, below Hostname), field types corrected (Bridge Service and Alert Service are switches, not dropdowns), Lab added alongside Standalone Campus and Connected Campus, the toast list completed, the load-time empty state documented, and the unbuilt 'Faculty-registered Rooms' modal section removed. The Proxy URL rules now point at the source document instead of restating it.

The Search bar in the page header now renders correctly. The magnifying-glass icon sits inside the field on its right edge instead of dropping below the field on its own line, and the field is vertically aligned with the Campus selector next to it again.

The Building Controller Proxy URL is now generated automatically from the associated Campus Hub and the Building Controller hostname, so it no longer has to be typed in. On a local Campus Hub it becomes https://<Campus Hub hostname>/<bc floor-number>/campus/; on the master Campus Hub (hub.atrium.test) it becomes https://<Building Controller hostname>/campus/. The rule depends only on which Campus Hub the Building Controller belongs to, never on its Node Type. Campus Hub and Relay Proxy URLs are unaffected — those stay manually entered.

Proxy URL moved below Campus Hub Association on the Create Node form, so it sits after the two fields it is generated from and fills in as soon as both are set — including while a new Campus Hub is being created in the same form. On Unarchive the archived value is prefilled.

The generated Proxy URL stays editable and explains itself. A hint on the line below the field reads 'Auto-generated from the Hostname and Campus Hub' and switches to 'Manually edited' the moment you change a character, with a 'Reset to generated URL' link on that same line to put the generated value back. A Proxy URL you edited yourself is never overwritten.

Renaming a Building Controller from the details panel regenerates its Proxy URL when you click Save, rather than rewriting the field as you type. Renaming to a hostname the rule cannot read keeps the existing URL instead of clearing it.

Hostnames the rule cannot read — legacy names such as engr-bc-studio.atrium.test with no bc<floor>-<n> pattern, or names that carry extra codes — are left blank with the hint 'Could not be auto-generated from this hostname — enter the Proxy URL manually.' Atrium never guesses a value; those are corrected by hand in the field.

Existing Building Controllers now show a Proxy URL: 29 of the 40 seeded nodes have one generated from their Campus Hub association, and the 11 with legacy hostnames stay blank to show the manual case.

Every Proxy URL field on the Building Controller, Campus Hub, and Timetable Relay panels has an open-in-new-tab button beside it — the same affordance as the Associated Campus Hub / Building Controller / Relay lists. It always opens the saved URL: editing the field does not re-point it, so a half-typed address can never be opened. It picks up your change when you click Save, and is greyed out when the saved Proxy URL is empty.

Hostname fields now show an example instead of 'Enter Hostname' — e.g. meds-bc1-4.atrium.test for Building Controllers, meds-hub.atrium.test for Campus Hubs, and meds-rly1-1.atrium.test for Timetable Relays.

Hostname is editable again from the details panel — on Building Controllers, Campus Hubs, and Timetable Relays. It is now the first field of the editable section on all three panels, instead of a read-only value in the information grid.

A Campus Hub's Hostname can only be renamed while no Building Controller is associated with it. When the Campus Hub has associated Building Controllers the field is read-only, with a hint below it — 'Remove all associated Building Controllers to edit.' Every other field on the panel stays editable.

New spare Campus Hub on MEDS — meds-hub2.atrium.test, with no Building Controllers registered on it yet. It is the one Campus Hub that shows an editable Hostname; every other Campus Hub has associated Building Controllers and is therefore read-only.

Hostname edits are validated the same way as the Create Node form: an empty value shows 'Hostname is required.' and a name already taken by another node (Building Controller, Campus Hub, or Relay — including archived ones) shows 'Hostname is already in use.' Both block the save.

Renaming a node updates everywhere it is referenced. A renamed Building Controller keeps its place in the Associated Building Controllers lists of its Campus Hub and Timetable Relays, and a renamed Campus Hub carries through to the Campus Hub Association shown on its Building Controllers and Timetable Relays.

Newly created Building Controllers now start with Registry Sync disabled. Previously the toggle showed as Enabled right after creation, even though the Create Node form has no Asset Registry field — access must be granted explicitly afterwards from the side panel, the campus cascade, or bulk mode.

Hostname is now read-only on the Building Controller side panel and is the first field shown, above IP Address — matching the Campus Hub and Relay panels. It is set on creation (or unarchive) and can no longer be edited from the details panel.

Requirements now document what the Export button is for: ad-hoc housekeeping lists of nodes (for example the set being updated, or information requested by the service desk) that can be taken offline. The same data is available from the telemetry dashboards, so the export is a convenience rather than the system of record.

Proxy URL is now editable directly from the details panel for Building Controllers, Campus Hubs, and Timetable Relays. On Building Controllers it sits right after Hostname; on Campus Hub and Timetable Relays it is the first editable field — matching the order and validation of the Create Node form.
Archiving a Building Controller no longer turns off its Registry Sync setting — the node keeps whatever value it had.
The Configuration panel (Registry Sync) now stays visible and editable on the side panel for archived Building Controllers, instead of being hidden.
New campus SOUT — a fully empty campus (no Building Controllers, Campus Hubs or Relays). It appears in the Campus multi-select and renders with an empty-state message.

Archiving a building controller that is scheduled for a Timetable Release is now blocked with an error toast ('This Building controller is scheduled for Timetable Release. Cancel the deploy before archiving.'). This validation applies to archiving only — disabling Registry Sync stays unrestricted.
Empty states across the prototype now use a single consistent icon (the tray glyph) instead of a mix of different icons.

Empty-state copy is now context-aware: a genuinely empty campus shows 'No Data' / 'This Campus has no data yet', while a campus whose building controllers are hidden by the active filters shows 'No Building Controllers Match Filters' / 'Adjust the filters to see results'.
Toast notifications now use the correct design-system semantic icons (checkmark for success, warning triangle for warning, and the standard error icon) instead of plain text characters.

Selecting campuses no longer auto-selects a node. The tree loads with nothing selected and the details panel shows an empty message — 'Select item(s) in the tree to load options'. Filter changes, reset filters, and clearing a selection all return to this empty state instead of jumping to the first campus.

Clear Selection button now appears whenever a Campus is selected (its highlight cascades across all the campus's building controllers), giving a one-click way to drop back to the empty state — matching the bulk-selection affordance.

Removed the 'scheduled for Timetable Release' validation that blocked disabling Registry Sync, on both the single building controller panel and bulk configuration. Registry Sync can now be disabled freely.
Tree now lists campuses alphabetically regardless of the order they were selected in.
Unarchive drawer title now names the campus — 'Unarchive Building Controller for <Campus>' — matching the Create Node wording.
An empty campus (all its faculties filtered out) now correctly shows Registry Sync as 'Unavailable'. Previously it could show 'Enabled' when another selected campus had matching results.

Create Node drawer no longer shows a stray divider line at the top of the form when the Campus field is hidden (Manage, Unarchive, and single-campus entries). The divider only appears when the Campus field is visible above it.

Bulk Configuration panel (2+ selected nodes) now uses the standard Save / Discard Changes footer instead of a dedicated 'Apply' button. Save runs the same effective-set cascade (with Timetable Release validation); Discard Changes reverts the Asset Registry toggle to its saved state. Both follow the shared dirty-state model — disabled until the toggle differs from the captured state.

Selecting a single Campus now shows the 'Bulk Configuration (N Building Controllers)' header (N = the campus's active building controllers) instead of 'Campus Details', treating a campus selection as a bulk configuration of its building controllers.

Bulk Configuration title now shows a single effective building-controller count — 'Bulk Configuration (N Building Controllers)' — for campus, building-controller, and mixed selections, replacing the previous 'N Campuses, M Building Controllers' breakdown.
Removed the standalone bulk 'Apply' button and its fixed footer; bulk configuration is committed through the shared side-panel Save button.

Campus panel Registry Sync toggle gains a fourth 'Unavailable' state — when the active tree filters (Faculties and/or Registry Sync) narrow the campus to zero non-archived building controllers, the input is disabled, the label reads 'Unavailable', and the info notice swaps to 'No building controllers match the current filters, so Registry Sync cannot be changed for this campus. Adjust the Faculties or Registry Sync filter to enable changes.'

Campus panel Registry Sync aggregate state now considers BOTH the Faculties filter and the Registry Sync filter (Enabled/Disabled/All), not just Faculties. The toggle reflects the Building Controllers visible under the current filters: picking 'Enabled' shows the toggle as Enabled, 'Disabled' shows Disabled, combined narrows compose, and zero matches → Unavailable.

Campus panel Asset Registry cascade on Save now writes only to building controllers visible under the current tree filters (Faculties ∩ Registry Sync). Previously the cascade respected only the Faculties filter; archived nodes continue to be untouched.

Campus panel Asset Registry cascade notice copy unified — when any filter is narrowed (Faculties narrowed OR Asset Registry filter ≠ All), the notice reads '…that match the current filters.' (was '…that match the current Faculties filter.'); the all-defaults copy now reads 'Use the filters to limit changes to a specific subset.' Multi-campus 'this campus' / 'a campus / that campus' wording is preserved on top.

Subheader Campus multi-select now exposes the search input (searchable: true) to match the Faculties multi-select, so both subheader scope dropdowns share the same dropdown layout (search input + Select All/None controls + list).

ProjMultiSelect plugin: Select All / None links now respect the active search term — they operate only on the items currently visible in the filtered list. When no search is active behavior is unchanged (selects/clears every item). Affects every prototype that uses the plugin.
Requirements document updated to v2.15 — FR-P2-05 rewritten to describe the four-state toggle, both-filter scoping, and the new empty-state notice copy.

Copy mirrors the per-campus multi-campus wording ("a campus / that campus") and swaps to the narrowed variant when the Faculties filter narrows the union of available faculties across the bulk-selected campuses. The notice stays hidden for building-controller bulk-selection (cascade explanation isn't relevant there).

Faculties filter now narrows each building controller's visible tag strip in the tree, not just which rows appear. The popover always carries the full sorted faculty set so users still see complete membership on hover. When the filter is at "all selected", behavior is unchanged.

Tree selection now uses a hands-free model, the same as Manage Devices. Plain click on a Building Controller stays single-select. Shift+hover paints a `.tree__node--range-preview` ahead of commit; ESC clears the bulk. Apply uses an effective set — the union of directly-picked Building Controllers and every active Building Controller under any picked Campus (de-duplicated) — and the Timetable Release guard still runs per Building Controller. Only the Configuration section (Registry Sync) is editable in bulk.
